notes.title: Hope River Town Update is Live! 🌵
notes.content:
Howdy folks,

We know you’ve been waiting a long time for this, and today we’re thrilled to finally bring you the biggest content update yet for Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton’s Journey!

This update has taken longer than expected, mainly because we wanted to implement proper gamepad support first (a highly requested feature). It delayed things by over a month, but we believe it was worth the wait, and now the new content is finally ready for you to discover.


[previewyoutube="fTbnZpXnBNQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

What’s New in This Update?


We’ve added over 1 hour of fresh gameplay content, bringing the total playtime of the Early Access version up to around 3 hours. Here’s what you’ll find in this update:

A New Town: Hope River Town

 If you remember Hope River from the demo, forget what you saw back then. We’ve overhauled almost everything. The only thing that remains the same is its name. The new Hope River Town is richer, deeper, and full of new stories waiting to be discovered.

14 New NPCs to Meet 

 Each with unique personalities and dialogue.

10+ New Quests 

 Expanding Jake’s journey with brand new challenges and decisions to make.

5 New Weapons 

 Fresh ways to fight your battles, both up close and at range.

10 New Outfits 

Customize Jake’s look and style to your liking.




Why the Delay?
As mentioned, this update was pushed back because we wanted to make sure accessibility features such as gamepad support, WASD movement, and auto-attack were fully functional before releasing new content. Many of you have requested it, and we understand the importance it holds for immersion and accessibility. We appreciate your patience, it’s finally here, and we hope it makes your experience even smoother.


What’s Next?
We’re getting closer to the end of Jake’s story. Most of the Early Access content is now in place, and you’re already seeing more than half of the full game.

From here on out, our main focus will be on finishing the story. If everything goes according to plan, we hope to wrap up development in the next 4–6 months. Of course, game development is unpredictable, so no promises, but that’s the goal.

At the same time, half of our team has already started working on our second project. It’s still too early to share much, but if you want to catch the first details when the time comes, make sure to follow us on our social media channels. 
 
 
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44980757/b9e06642e24be956be4eb56134628a5e52ad2f91.pngThank You
Your feedback and support mean the world to us. This project is being built with your input at every step, and we couldn’t do it without you. Please keep sharing your thoughts on our Steam Discussion; we read every single one.

So saddle up, head into Hope River Town, and let us know what you think!

See you on the dusty trail,
The Storyforge Team

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.content:
Howdy!

Since we first launched Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton’s Journey, one question has echoed louder than any other: “When will controller support arrive?”

We wish we could have delivered it from the start, but when we first began development, we designed the entire game around keyboard and mouse. Implementing full controller support now means ripping out the existing input system and rebuilding it from scratch and that would push our 1.0 release back at least two months. For a tiny indie team like ours, a two-month delay could be a death knell.

Every time someone asked about controller support, we’d clash in the dev chat, our programmer even blocked me on Discord for a while in frustration! We have just one programmer in our team, and between polishing the Early Access map “Hope Town” and gearing up for full launch, our days and nights blur together.

Then we got a message that changed everything:

 Same my daughter.  She keeps watching the video lol and says, "Mama...I love this game already, and havent even played it."  She has nerve damage in her right arm and hand from a birth defect.  So she needs gamepad support and auto aim and auto attack in games.  So please Mr. Developer 2....tell Mr. Developer 1.....guy with coffee..... its for a few people who love this game already and are disabled.  Maybe he will feel more empathetic if he hears the truth behind why we ask and why its so important to us.  Offer him a hug maybe too...he needs a friend to encourage him and tell him how great he is.  Have him hop on here and I will tell him myself. 

Her daughter’s story broke our hearts and she wasn’t alone. Dozens of players reached out asking for more accessible controls.

Suddenly, this wasn’t about deadlines or obstacles. It was about responsibility. A little girl was locked out of our world, and the only barrier was us. That had to change.

So we dropped everything else, rolled up our sleeves, and pulled multiple all-nighters. It was brutal, but we never gave up. And now —drumroll, please— Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton’s Journey offers full controller support with auto-attack! 🎉

We:

 Rebuilt our input system from the ground up to recognize every major controller.
 Recrafted menus and HUD so you can navigate with thumbsticks and d-pads.
 Added auto-aim and auto-attack toggles so players of all abilities can enjoy combat.


We set out to share our story with everyone, and we believe no one should be left behind.

Thank you for your patience and welcome to the adventure!

With love,
The Storyforge Team

notes.title: Auto Attack and WASD Movement Update!
notes.content:
Since we released the very first demo of Dust&Courage: Jake Bolton's Journey, we’ve heard three big, recurring requests from you:


 WASD movement
 Auto-attack
 And of course, gamepad support


We’ve been all ears from day one and doing our best to bring these features to life alongside you. After a bit of gentle pressure (and maybe annoying our dev just enough times), one day he finally snapped, in the best way possible. He paused everything and went off to build a whole new system.

The result? You can now move with WASD and enable auto-attack, no more relying solely on the mouse!

To try these new features out, just update to the latest version of the game and head over to the Settings menu. We’ve made sure you can toggle them on or off however you like, so if you prefer the old-school controls, that’s totally cool too.

Now, let’s talk gamepad support.

This one means a lot, not just to you, but to us as well. We’ve always known how important it is for everyone to be able to play the game comfortably, and folks using a Steam Deck. But truth be told, making this happen earlier would’ve pushed our full release back by at least two months.

So… we asked our dev again. And again. And again. We may have been banned from Discord a few times in the process. But then one day, something changed. A message struck a chord, and just like that, he rolled up his sleeves and got to work on full gamepad support.

Yes, really. The “impossible” feature is now in development!

While we’re moving fast, we can’t give an exact release date just yet. But rest assured, it’s coming very soon.

If you’ve read this far… hey there!
Hope you’re having a great week. Thanks so much for all your support, feedback, and patience. We’re beyond grateful ❤️

With love,
The Storyforge Team

notes.title: Early Access Starts Today! - Let's Celebrate Together!
notes.content:
What Can You Expect from Early Access?

Get ready to dive into Jake Bolton’s thrilling journey! Here's a quick overview of what you can expect in our Early Access release:

Jake’s Story Begins: The game opens up with the start of Jake’s bold and dangerous adventure. Players will begin to uncover his past and catch glimpses of the bigger story ahead.
Four New Maps: Explore four new maps that you've never seen before, each offering unique environments and challenges.
Brand New NPCs: Meet new characters that will add depth to the game’s world and offer exciting new quests and interactions.
New Weapons: Equip yourself with an array of new weapons to tackle your enemies. Choose strategically to adapt to the challenges you’ll face.
New Quest Trees: Dive into fresh quests and branching storylines. Each decision will lead to different outcomes and paths in Jake’s journey.

What’s Coming Next?

This is just the beginning! We’re not stopping with Early Access. In the next two months, we’re planning to release a major update that will include:

A New Town: A new town will be introduced, featuring interactive shops and a large saloon.
New Shops: You’ll be able to enter shops and purchase different items from various vendors. Each shop will offer its own unique goods and atmosphere.
New Locations, Quests, and Characters: As always, we’ll be adding more places to explore, new quests to take on, and more characters to meet, expanding the world of Dust & Courage.

What About the 1.0 Release?

We aim for a 6-8 month journey toward the 1.0 release. Throughout this period, your feedback will play a crucial role in shaping the game. Please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts and ideas with us! Your feedback is not only a source of motivation for us but also directly influences the future of the game.

If we see even more enthusiasm and requests from our player base than expected, we might extend the development by a few months, allowing us to add a broader story and finalize the game with a more expansive conclusion.

There’s More to Come!
Don’t worry, this is only the beginning! There’s still so much more to share about Dust & Courage. More updates, new content, and exciting developments are on the way. Stay tuned!

With love,
Team Storyforge

notes.title: We’re in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that we’ve officially hit a big milestone: we’re part of Steam Next Fest! 🎉 As we are getting closer to our Early Access release, this is a huge moment for the whole team, and we want you to celebrate it with us.

Play the Free Demo

Starting now, you can jump in and try out the free demo during Steam Next Fest! Whether you’ve been following our journey for a while or you’re just discovering the project, this is your chance to get a hands-on experience with what we’ve been working so hard to bring to life.

We Want Your Feedback!
We’re on the home stretch, but your thoughts are as valuable as ever. Play the demo, explore, test things out, and let us know what you think! Every bit of feedback helps us fine-tune the experience before we launch into Early Access. You can share your feedback in the comments section or on our Discord channel.

Thank you all for your support so far, we’re happy to have you with us on this journey. Now, let’s enjoy Steam Next Fest together!

Safe travels, and see ya 'round! 🤠
The Storyforge Team

notes.title: Major Update: We’ve Redesigned Our Characters!
notes.content:
Howdy, cowboys!

We are thrilled to bring you our very first devlog, packed with exciting news. Dust&Courage: Jake Bolton's Journey is our first indie game, and it holds a special place in our hearts. Bringing this project to life has been like experiencing the excitement of a new adventure. As a small team of four, we had no idea how massive this project would become, but now we’re on the verge of completing our first demo.

What started as a mere dream has transformed into a fully-fledged game studio, and here we stand, a team of four long-time friends, united by a shared passion. Our 20-year friendship has significantly influenced this project, with some of us even leaving our professional careers to pursue game development full-time. We aim to channel this excitement into creating the best experience for you.

Since our prototype, there have been numerous improvements we've aimed to make. Our primary goal has always been to tell a compelling story. We consider ourselves storytellers first and game developers second, and we want to reflect that in our games. Although we have finished writing the story for our game, there are still many aspects we want to enhance. We started with visual changes. Since launching our Steam page, we’ve updated our character designs to offer you a more unique gaming experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980757/20eeb256f1559877231db4351ca09353d7e413b8.gif

In addition to updating our main character, Jake, we have almost completely redesigned our game world. We’ve revamped nearly every area from scratch, and we can’t wait to show them to you. Alongside these changes, we’ve also updated the visuals, text, and layout of our Steam page. We hope you’ll enjoy the new look.

Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, so please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts. You can reach us through the Steam discussion section or join our Discord channel. Our development team is eager to answer your questions and chat with you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980757/b9e06642e24be956be4eb56134628a5e52ad2f91.png

With love,
The Storyforge Team
